title: Fix Company B publication recovery state machine
objective: Fix only the executable Company B queue recovery state machine identified by PM and Codex. Start from the clean B-TASK-003 result. Do not reuse B-TASK-004 or B-TASK-005 worktrees. Make post-PASS publication recovery transactional, bounded, and fail-closed, and add deterministic regression tests. Documentation and scheduler work are explicitly deferred.
acceptance_criteria: Recoverable publication failures may be visibly company-b:blocked, but automatic resume is allowed only when saved queue state matches the same task/branch and the authoritative worker state is status PASS, phase DONE, reviewVerdict PASS.

Before publication-only recovery proceeds, fixed-test evidence and Codex review evidence must be revalidated; absent, malformed, mismatched, non-PASS, or invalid evidence revokes recovery eligibility and must not remain an automatic recovery candidate.
Recovery after validated PASS/DONE must never invoke company-b-worker.ps1 again; it may retry only remote branch, Draft PR, exact-head evidence, and lifecycle publication.

The final lifecycle completion must tolerate partial failure: if the done label mutation succeeds but the completion comment fails, the next invocation must deterministically rediscover that saved recovery transaction and finish safely rather than strand an undiscoverable done Issue.
Queued Issues with an existing task runtime but without a matching saved validated publication-recovery transaction must still fail closed.
Set the production queue wrapper default BaseRef to company-b/operational-v0.1.

Add deterministic regression tests covering blocked publication recovery, partial final label-success/comment-failure recovery, stale recovery eligibility after evidence invalidation, rejection of non-PASS or mismatched state, no worker reinvocation during publication-only recovery, and the operational default BaseRef.
Do not modify QUEUE_PROTOCOL.md in this task; documentation alignment is a separate follow-up after executable behavior passes.
Do not add scheduler or heartbeat behavior.
Existing pytest suite plus updated queue contract tests must pass.
Final independent Codex review must return PASS.
